changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
create or alter view [security].[RuleOwner] with schemabinding as select r.Id as RuleId, r.SecurityType, r_then.SecurityId from security.[Rule] r inner join security.[Role] ro on ro.Id = r.RoleId inner join security.RuleThen r_then on r_then.Id = r.Id GO
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.indexes where name = 'IX_Security_RuleOwner') BEGIN create unique clustered index [IX_Security_RuleOwner] ON [security].[RuleOwner] ( RuleId asc, SecurityType asc, SecurityId asc ) END
